control.description-key: PBS Hub Ops Console: add a host or edit one (identity, package, join date, score limits, bank and personal data). Personal data is never loaded: the form shows masked values and sends only fields typed in.

property.name: Context
property.description-key: JSON {userEmail,userName,roles,permissions,config}. Saving needs HOST_EDIT; personal data (KTP, rekening, alamat, telepon, email pribadi) needs HOST_PII_VIEW. config.packages: optional package list when PackagesJson is empty.

property.name: HostJson
property.description-key: JSON row of the host to edit, same masked shape as HostDetail (ID, Title, HostCode, NamaHost, Email, Package, JoinDate, InitialScore, MinimumScore, MaximumScore, Bank, Modified, KtpLast4, NorekLast4, PhoneLast4, HasAlamat, HasNamaRekening, HasPersonalEmail). Empty: add a new host.

property.name: HostsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of all hosts (ID, Title, HostCode, NamaHost, Email) for duplicate checks and the next Host ID.

property.name: PackagesJson
property.description-key: JSON of the Package choices of [Host - PBS Hub]: rows with Value.

property.name: IsLoading
property.description-key: true while canvas is loading: renders skeleton rows.

property.name: ActionResult
property.description-key: Canvas reply {requestId,status,message}. SAVE_HOST locks until it comes back.
